results.note: Commentariorum in Genesim: No English translation found despite extensive searching. Genesis commentaries by Rabanus are mentioned in bibliographies but not available in English.
Commentarium in Matthaeum: Only partial/pedagogical translations found (Ave Maria University has excerpt on Matt 3-4:11). No complete published English translation identified.

De clericorum institutione: English translation 'On the Formation of Clergy' by Owen M. Phelan, published by Catholic University of America Press, Fathers of the Church: Mediaeval Continuations series, 2023.

De laudibus Sanctae Crucis: English translation 'In Honor of the Holy Cross' by May Peterson available on Global Medieval Sourcebook (Stanford), under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.
Liber de computo: No English translation found. Latin critical edition by J. McCulloh and W. Stevens exists in Corpus Christianorum continuatio mediaevalis 44 (1997), but no English version located.
Liber de oblatione puerorum: No English translation found. Work on infant oblation practices written c. 829 exists only in Latin sources.
Commentaria in Exodum: No English translation found despite searching for Exodus commentary translations.
Commentaria in librum Josue: No English translation found for the Joshua commentary.
Commentaria in librum Judicum: No English translation found for the Judges commentary.

Commentarium in librum Ruth: English translation included in Scriptorium Press volume 'Saints of the Old Testament: Rabanus Maurus' Commentary on Ruth, Judith, and Esther' (2023), paperback and Kindle editions available on Amazon.
Enarratio super Deuteronomium: No English translation found for the Deuteronomy commentary.
Enarrationes in librum Numerorum: No English translation found for the Numbers commentary.
Epistola dedicatoria: Short prefatory letter; no English translation found.
Expositiones in Leviticum: No English translation found for the Leviticus commentary despite searching.
Praefatio 1: Short preface; no English translation found.
Commentaria in Ecclesiasticum: No English translation found for this commentary on Ecclesiasticus.
Commentaria in Paralipomena: No English translation found for the Chronicles commentary.
Commentaria in libros Machabaeorum: No English translation found for the Maccabees commentary.
Commentaria in libros Regum: No English translation found for the Kings commentary.
Commentaria in librum Sapientiae: No English translation found for the Wisdom commentary.
Expositio in librum Esther: English translation included in Scriptorium Press volume 'Saints of the Old Testament: Rabanus Maurus' Commentary on Ruth, Judith, and Esther' (2023).
Expositio in librum Judith: English translation included in Scriptorium Press volume 'Saints of the Old Testament: Rabanus Maurus' Commentary on Ruth, Judith, and Esther' (2023).
Commentaria in Ezechielem: No complete English translation found. Partial excerpts on specific passages appear in Patristic Bible Commentary websites, but no comprehensive translation identified.
De consanguineorum nuptiis: No English translation found for this brief treatise on consanguineous marriages.

De magicis artibus: Partial English translation in 'European Magic and Witchcraft: a reader' (2018, pp. 143-145) translated by Martha Rampton. Full translation by Raphael F. Wersinger appears available on Google Books.
Homiliae: No English translation found despite extensive searching. Work exists in Latin and Polish translation mentioned, but no English version located.
Martyrologium: No English translation found. Rabanus compiled this liturgical calendar of saints c. 845, but no published English translation identified.
Opuscula: No English translation found for this collection of minor works.
Poenitentiale: No English translation found. Rabanus prepared penitential books, but no published English translation identified.
Praefatio: Short preface; no English translation found.
Prologus: Short prologue; no English translation found.
Quota generatione licitum sit connubium: No English translation found for this brief treatise on permissible degrees of consanguinity.
Tractatus de anima: No English translation found for this treatise on the soul.
Commentaria in Jeremiam: No English translation found for the Jeremiah commentary.

De universo: English translation 'Hrabanus Maurus: De Universo: the peculiar properties of words and their mystical significance' by Priscilla Throop, 2 vols., published by MedievalMS (Charlotte, VT), 2009.
Enarrationes in Epistolas Beati Pauli: No English translation found. Rabanus commented on Paul's Epistles 836-840, but no published English translation identified.
Expositio in Proverbia Salomonis: No English translation found for the Proverbs commentary.
Allegoriae in universam sacram scripturam: No English translation found for this allegorical work on Scripture.
Carmina de diversis: No English translation found. Some poems by Rabanus appear in Helen Waddell's 'Mediaeval Latin Lyrics,' but no specific translation of this work located.
Commentaria in Cantica: No English translation found for the Song of Songs commentary.
De ecclesiastica disciplina: No English translation found for this treatise on ecclesiastical discipline.
De inventione linguarum: No English translation found for this brief work on the origin of languages.
De passione Domini: No English translation found for this treatise on the Passion of Christ.
De videndo Deum de puritate cordis et modo poenitentiae: No English translation found for this work on seeing God, purity of heart, and penance.
De vita B. Mariae Magdalenae et Marthae: No English translation found for this work on the lives of Mary Magdalene and Martha.
